title: Sr. Sales Manager - Walmart/Sam's Club
description:
Position: Sr. Sales Manager – Walmart/Sam’s Club

Location: Bentonville, Arkansas

Position Summary:

Under the general direction of the VP of Sales and Sr. Director of Sales in the Home Entertainment department, Hisense is looking for a high-performing Sr. Sales Manager to help us meet our growth targets in television and sound bar in Walmart Stores and Sam’s Club. This person will be responsible for meeting television and sound bar sales goals, achieving forecast targets, crafting sell in plans and justifying plans with Hisense upper management and business planning. In addition, they are responsible for formulating innovative business development strategies and providing vision for sales strategies and their execution. This position will be responsible for maximizing marketing, advertising, events, and training budgets while ensuring Hisense is represented as a top leader in the industry.  They will act as the face of the company at various major retailers, while acting as a liaison for Hisense internal departments.

Duties/Responsibilities:

• Collaborate with Sr. Director of Sales to develop short- and long-term strategic plans, including the preparation of annual Business plans and budget

• Heavy involvement in creating and maintaining a 90 and 120-day rolling sell in plan by account

• Conduct weekly and daily sales forecasts and account reviews to create reports and compare against objectives

• Achieving shelf share goals during annual assortment summits by account

• Conduct and help direct weekly/bi-weekly CPFR calls with customers along with business planning

• Manage assigned budgets while consistently seeking revenue and cost optimization

• Negotiate annual vendor program agreements by account while forecasting and tracking associated expenditures

• Manage financial risks as it relates to customer deductions and offsets

• Ensure organization-wide programs and events are administered, representing Hisense as a world class consumer electronics brand

• Manage executive relationships and metrics with key regional accounts including inventory levels, turns, contracts, quarterly corporate business reviews, periodic business reviews, and drive increased sales within the accounts as assigned

• Act as the liaison for assigned customer’s online portals

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree or higher

• At least 5 years of Sales experience with televisions and sound bars, preferably with Walmart or Sam’s Club

• Experience developing sales forecasts

• Experience with creating innovative business development strategies and providing vision for sales strategies and their execution

title: HR Manager
description:
Human Resources Manager – Alpharetta, GA

Position Summary:
We are seeking a seasoned and forward‑thinking HR professional to lead employee relations and performance, recruiting, and HR compliance to support a broad range of generalist responsibilities. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast‑paced environment, builds trusted partnerships across the organization, and promotes a culture rooted in fairness, inclusion, and high performance. The HR Manager will play a key role in ensuring compliance with all applicable U.S. labor laws while driving continuous improvement in HR processes and employee experience.

Key Responsibilities:
Employee Relations & Performance

• Support employee relations matters, including investigations, conflict resolution, and performance management initiatives.

• Provide guidance to managers on coaching, documentation, and corrective action processes.
HR Systems, Benefits & Reporting.

• Assist with benefits administration and ensure HRIS data accuracy and integrity.

• Prepare monthly HR reports and support analytics‑driven decision‑making.

• Partner with leadership to enhance HR processes, employee engagement, and retention.

Talent Acquisition & Onboarding

• Lead and manage full‑cycle recruitment, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, selection, and onboarding.

• Partner with hiring managers to develop job descriptions, workforce plans, and effective hiring strategies aligned with business needs.

Compliance & HR Operations

• Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local employment laws (FLSA, ADA, FMLA, EEOC, pay transparency, and others).

• Conduct internal audits, maintain accurate and compliant employee records, and administer HR policies and procedures.

• Monitor evolving HR compliance requirements and deliver timely updates and training to leadership and staff.

Qualifications:
•     Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field (SHRM‑CP or PHR preferred).
•     5–10 years of progressive HR experience with demonstrated expertise in employee relations, training, recruitment and employment law compliance.
•     Strong understanding of full‑cycle recruiting and HR best practices.
•     Comprehensive knowledge of multi‑state employment laws and regulations.
•     Exceptional communication, interpersonal, and problem‑solving abilities.
•     Proven ability to work both independently and collaboratively across departments.
•     Experience in a fast‑paced, high‑growth, or scaling organization.

title: Regional After Sales Support & Training Manager - Northwest
description:
Location: Remote in the NW region of U.S., must live in either the state of Washington or Oregon

Overview:

The After Sales Support & Training Manager will be responsible for delivering regional technical support, product training, and field service assistance for Hisense HVAC residential and light commercial products within the assigned market. This role will serve as a key technical resource for distributors, contractors, sales teams, and internal support teams by answering technical support calls, providing in-person and remote training, and supporting occasional on-site startup, troubleshooting, and quality assurance testing for inverter unitary side discharge, top discharge, ductless, and VRF products, with a primary focus on single-phase applications

Duties/Responsibilities:

• Serve as the primary after-sales technical support and training resource for Hisense HVAC products within the assigned region.

• Answer incoming technical support calls and provide clear, professional troubleshooting guidance to distributors, contractors, sales representatives, and internal support teams.

• Provide in-person, remote, and classroom-based training for distributors and contractors covering installation, startup, service, troubleshooting, and best practices for Hisense HVAC products.

• Conduct occasional on-site startup assistance, troubleshooting, and quality assurance testing as needed for inverter unitary side discharge, top discharge, ductless, and VRF systems.

• Support primarily single-phase inverter-based products while maintaining working knowledge of applicable product lines, installation requirements, controls, diagnostics, and service procedures.

• Partner with distributors and contractors to improve product knowledge, installation quality, troubleshooting capability, and customer satisfaction throughout the assigned market.

• Document field issues, training needs, product feedback, quality concerns, and recurring technical questions to support continuous improvement across service, training, product, and warranty processes.

• Assist with the development of service, installation, troubleshooting, and training content for Hisense HVAC support tools, apps, and customer-facing resources.

Requirements/Qualifications:

• Associate degree or HVAC related technical certification required. Bachelor’s degree is preferred.

• 2+ years of experience with in-field product support on residential and light commercial HVAC systems (Unitary, Ductless, Packaged Units, Rooftop Units, Inverter-based Systems, VRF, etc.).

• Experience providing classroom and hand-on HVAC technical training.

• Ability to provide in-person and online training and technical support to customers.

• Excellent communications skills, and the ability to give professional presentations and instructions.

• Skilled with Microsoft Office tools, such as PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Outlook, Teams.

• Ability to problem solve and multitask.

• Ability to work well in groups and take instruction from others.

• Ability to travel up to 30% within the United States and Canada.

• Motivated self-starter with the ability to work independently while supporting key business and leadership objectives.

title: Logistics Inbound Manager
description:
Overview:

The Logistics Inbound Manager is the role for optimizing and streamlining the supply chain and logistics operations of the company. The primary responsibility will be to lead the end-to-end logistics process from Mexico factory or China origin through final customers. It will analyze and evaluate the entire logistics process and operation data, identifying areas for improvement and implementing strategies to enhance efficiency and cost-effectiveness. Analytical skills and attention to detail will be instrumental in ensuring smooth and timely movement of goods throughout the supply chain, minimizing delays and maximizing customer satisfaction.

Duties & Responsibilities:

• Data Analysis: Collect, analyze, and interpret data related to logistics operations, including transportation, warehousing, inventory, and distribution. Use this data to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities for improvement.

• Monitor shipments and ensure that they are delivered on time and in good condition.

• Supply Chain Optimization: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including procurement, operations, and customer service, to optimize the supply chain process. Ensure the right products are available at the right locations and at the right times to meet customer demands.

• Performance Metrics: Develop and maintain key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the efficiency and effectiveness of logistics processes. Regularly monitor and report on KPIs to identify deviations and propose corrective actions.

• Cost Management: Identify cost-saving opportunities within the logistics process while maintaining high-quality standards. Analyze vendor performance costs, transportation and warehousing costs, negotiate contracts, and work to reduce overall expenses.

Qualifications/Requirements:

• Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Operations Management, Business Management or a related field of study

• 3 or more years of relevant experience in Logistics or Supply Chain

• Some Supply Chain experience with international suppliers and carriers

• Ability to lead the full end-to-end process with experience in international shipment management and carrier management, as well as order management and cost analysis

• Capability to manage and lead carrier bidding processes

• Ability to perform daily, weekly, and monthly monitoring, and to troubleshoot issues with cross-functional teams

• Proficient in Excel (Pivot Table & Lookup function are required) and PowerPoint

• Strong written and verbal communication and negotiation skills

• Willing and able to travel internationally and domestically (up to 50%)

Preferred Skills:

• Bilingual in English and Chinese (Mandrin) or Spanish

• Electronics logistics experience preferred

• Experience with SAP and TMS or other logistics software preferred

title: Logistics Planning & Analytics Manager
description:
Overview:

The Logistics Planning & Analytics Manager is a data-driven leader responsible for forecasting, modeling, and reporting logistics and warehouse operations. This role drives decision-making through KPI management, predictive analytics, and performance reporting, ensuring operational efficiency, cost control, and continuous improvement. The ideal candidate combines deep analytical skills with practical logistics experience to transform data into actionable insights and executive-level presentations.

Responsibilities:

Logistics Forecasting & Modeling

• Build, maintain, and continuously improve logistics and warehouse forecasting models for capacity, inventory flow, and seasonal demand

• Develop predictive analytics to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for cost savings and operational efficiency

• Support strategic planning initiatives by providing data-driven recommendations

KPI Management & Data Analytics

• Own core warehouse and logistics KPIs, including:

• Logistics Expense Rate

• Inventory Accuracy

• Damage Rate

• Warehouse Utilization Rate

• Collect, validate, and analyze KPI data from multiple systems (WMS, ERP, 3PL data)

• Identify gaps, trends, and anomalies in operational performance

Reporting & Presentations

• Create clear, actionable, and visually compelling dashboards and reports using Power BI and Advanced Excel

• Prepare executive-level presentations and operational summaries for leadership review

• Translate complex data into insights that drive decisions on space utilization, cost reduction, and service improvements

Process Improvement & Collaboration

• Partner with warehouse operations, finance, and 3PL providers to implement improvements informed by data insights

• Recommend and support system enhancements, automation, and best practices

• Lead initiatives to reduce logistics costs, improve inventory accuracy, and optimize warehouse space

*Ability to travel up to 25% of the time as required.

Skills & Qualifications:

Technical Skills:

• Advanced proficiency in Excel (pivot tables, Power Query, complex formulas)

• Strong experience with Power BI or similar data visualization tools

• Data analytics and statistical modeling experience

• Experience with WMS/ERP systems

• Forecasting, scenario modeling, and KPI analysis

Professional Skills:

• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities

• Ability to synthesize complex data into executive-level insights and presentations

• Detail-oriented with a focus on accuracy and actionable insights

• Effective collaboration and communication across cross-functional teams

Experience:

• 7+ years in logistics, warehouse operations, or supply chain analytics

• Proven track record in logistics forecasting, KPI management, and reporting

• Experience working with 3PL providers preferred

Key Success Metrics:

• Accurate and actionable logistics forecasting

• Improved KPI performance: lower expense rate, higher inventory accuracy, reduced damage, better warehouse utilization

• High-quality dashboards and presentations that inform leadership decisions

• Continuous improvement initiatives implemented and measured

title: Senior Planning Analyst
description:
JOB TITLE: Senior Planning Analyst

JOB DUTIES:

Senior Planning Analyst is responsible for demand & supply forecasting, inventory optimization, production planning, & cross-functional coordination to ensure efficient, data-driven supply chain operations & performance. Specific job duties include, but are not limited to the following:

•
Collect and analyze sell-in forecasts from the sales team, transforming these data points into comprehensive supply forecasts using Data Analysis (Excel). Ensure these forecasts account for arrival schedules, existing inventory levels, and potential market fluctuations to maintain an optimal Demand & Supply Planning.

• Evaluate orders with the factory based on its production capacity & capability under Production & Capacity Planning. Strategically schedule orders to align with customer demand while minimizing inventory costs. This involves close coordination with the factory & internal teams under Cross-functional Coordination, ensuring timely & efficient production planning while avoiding overstock & stockouts.

• Update & maintain daily inventory reports using ERP Systems (SAP) & Data Analysis (Excel), providing accurate & timely data on current inventory levels. Monitor inventory turnover rates; apply Inventory Management principles to ensure efficient use of resources. Collaborate with the sales team; develop strategies for managing & reducing aging inventory, optimizing stock levels & improving overall inventory health.

• Work closely with various departments, including sales, production, and logistics, under Cross-functional Coordination, to align supply chain activities with overall business goals. Foster strong communication channels to facilitate smooth flow of information; address any supply chain issues promptly.

• Identify opportunities for process improvements within the supply chain; implement best practices and innovative solutions. Enhance forecasting accuracy under Demand & Supply Planning, improve inventory control under Inventory Management; optimize order fulfillment processes to increase overall efficiency and effectiveness.

• Develop & implement Production planning strategies to improve operational efficiency, throughput & order fulfillment performance.

• Design & implement inventory optimization frameworks, including safety stock modeling & reorder point analysis, applying Inventory Management and optimization, Inventory reporting, and Data Analysis (Excel; Power BI) to support efficient inventory positioning.

• Lead cross-functional coordination by consolidating inputs from sales, operations & finance teams under aligning demand, supply & business objectives.

• Identify constraints & conduct supply chain risk assessment by analyzing demand variability, supply disruptions & capacity constraints using Data Analysis (Excel; Power BI) and Supply chain risk assessment, while applying Production & Capacity Planning and Demand & Supply Planning to develop mitigation strategies ensuring operational continuity.

• Lead Supply chain process improvement initiatives and planning system enhancements, including automation, data integration & workflow optimization, leveraging ERP Systems (SAP), and Data Analysis (Excel; Power BI) to drive operational efficiency.

• Develop and maintain supply chain KPI development & performance tracking frameworks using Data Analysis (Excel; Power BI) & Inventory reporting to measure forecasting accuracy, planning efficiency & overall supply chain performance.

• Utilize MS Excel and Power BI to prepare executive-level summaries, dashboards, and planning insights, applying & integrating outputs from ERP Systems (SAP) to support data-driven decision-making across the supply chain.

• Provide data-driven recommendations based on data analysis to support strategic supply chain planning & continuous improvement initiatives.

JOB REQUIREMENTS:

At least a Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business, or a closely related field, plus minimum Two years of post-baccalaureate experience working as Supply Chain Planning Analyst, Supply Chain Analyst, Logistics Analyst, Logistics Engineers, or closely related positions. Foreign degree equivalent is acceptable. We will also accept any suitable combination of education, training and/or experience. Experience should include working on Demand and Supply Planning; Production and Capacity Planning; Inventory Management; Inventory reporting; Cross-functional Coordination; order fulfillment processes optimization; Monitoring inventory turnover rates; Supply chain process improvement; working with Data Analysis Excel, and ERP Systems (SAP).

HOURS: M-F, 9:00 a.m. – 6:00 p.m.

JOB LOCATION: Alpharetta, GA 30005

title: Bilingual D2C Operations Specialist
description:
Job Responsibilities:

1. Order Processing:

• Review and verify new shop orders, exclude high-risk orders, record them in the transaction log, and forward them to the relevant OM team for processing.

• Check the order return requests, investigate shipping status, and communicate with customers regarding return shipments.

• Update order shipping information and notify customers via email.

• Monitor FedEx delivery risks, notify users via email, and assist in scheduling deliveries with FedEx to prevent lost shipments.

2. Online Support, Email Support, and Customer Inquiries:

• Respond to customer inquiries via online chat.

• Check customer response emails daily and provide timely answers.

• Forward inquiries related to TVs and large appliances to the after-sales team.

• Assist the customer service center in addressing D2C-related and laser product inquiries.

3. Returns and Refund Processing:

• Monitor customer return requests daily and coordinate with the warehouse to intercept shipments.

• If interception is unsuccessful or the product has already been shipped, create a return shipping label and guide the customer on returning the product.

• Confirm receipt of returned items at the warehouse and process refunds accordingly.

• Follow up with the service team to process returns in the SAP system.

4. Chargeback and FedEx Lost Shipment Handling:

• Monitor chargeback issues daily and report them to platform immediately upon detection.

• File claims with FedEx for lost shipments, provide necessary evidence, and follow up until the claim is resolved.

5.FedEx Delivery Follow-up:

• Notify customers via email, SMS, or phone calls if initial FedEx delivery attempts fail, ensuring successful delivery.

• Verify with the warehouse that returned products are received and in good condition.

• Ensure synchronization with the SAP system.

6. Inventory and Price Maintenance:

• Update inventory on a weekly basis.

• Adjust pricing weekly.

• Update the deal list weekly.

• Prepare monthly tax reports.

• Compile monthly order statistics.

• Reconcile accounts with the finance team on a weekly basis.

7. Finance audit

• Weekly work with Finance team to close the open case.

Job Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree in E-commerce, Graphic Design, Marketing, Business, or a related field.

• 2+ years of hands-on experience operating Shopify or other e-commerce platforms.

• Experience with SAP or other ERP/order management systems.

• Experience managing daily website operations, including product listings, pricing, inventory, promotions, orders, and content updates.

• Familiarity with e-commerce marketing activities, including promotions, discount campaigns, email marketing, and website traffic management.

• Basic understanding of Google Analytics / GA4 and e-commerce performance metrics such as traffic, conversion rate, orders, and revenue.

• Ability to coordinate with internal teams, including sales, marketing, logistics, customer service, and IT.

• Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.

• Fluent in both English and Chinese (Mandarin), with strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel and PowerPoint.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience with Shopify Admin, Shopify apps, and website merchandising.

• Experience with consumer electronics or other retail/e-commerce businesses.

• Basic knowledge of SEO, digital advertising, and social media marketing.

• Experience with order fulfillment, returns, refunds, shipping, and inventory management.

• Graphic design skills and experience with tools such as Adobe Photoshop or Illustrator are a plus.

title: Bilingual North America Service Operations Manager
description:
Overview:

The Bilingual North America Service Operations Manager is responsible for overseeing after-sales service strategies and operations in the United States, Canada, and Mexico. This position involves developing and implementing service strategies, managing and improving regional service KPI performance, improving service quality and customer satisfaction, and developing service processes and intelligent service capabilities.

Duties & Responsibilities:

• Lead the development and execution of service strategies across North America, define key business priorities and implementation roadmaps for each subsidiary, and strengthen service capabilities.

• Manage service KPIs, guide and support subsidiaries in improving service performance, and ensure that performance targets are met or exceeded.

• Manage customer satisfaction and Net Promoter Score (NPS), analyze key drivers, develop and implement improvement plans, and enhance the customer experience to achieve industry-leading NPS.

• Guide and drive capability development across regional and subsidiary call centers, service networks, spare parts supply, technical support, and product returns management.

• Analyze and manage service process quality across subsidiaries, monitor key process metrics, identify service issues, and drive corrective actions to improve service quality.

• Develop value-added service businesses, including spare parts sales, extended warranties, and product maintenance, to increase service revenue and profitability.

• Review and optimize service processes from the customer’s perspective, simplify customer journeys, establish service standards, reduce service turnaround times, and improve operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.

• Lead service digitalization and AI initiatives, plan service IT systems and AI agent projects, and oversee implementation and delivery as the business owner.

• At least 3 years of experience in service operations, home appliances, or consumer electronics.

• Fluency in both Mandarin Chinese and English.

• Strong leadership, communication, project management, and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to analyze performance metrics and implement improvement strategies.

• Familiarity with service management platforms, and digital tools.

• A bachelor’s degree or higher is required, preferably in business, science, or engineering.
